statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let window := fun x p : ℕ => (block x).filter (fun n => p^100000≤n^132301); let phase := fun p k (t : ℕ) => 2*Real.pi*(k : ℝ)*(t : ℝ)/(p : ℝ); let rootWave := fun q k t : ℕ => 2*Real.cos (phase q k t); let good := fun p a b r v : ℕ => p.Prime ∧ 2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0090 · 逐频控制真实移动窗上替换根相位的误差
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0090 · Bound the root-phase replacement error on the actual moving window at one frequency

brief.zh: 逆元互反把根对的误差压到 4πk/p。QP-0037 的几何和与 k≤√p≤p/2 给窗口和 ≤p/(2k)，所以每频归一化损失 ≤2π/p。
brief.en: Reciprocity bounds the paired-root error by 4πk/p. QP-0037 and k≤√p≤p/2 give a window sum at most p/(2k). The normalized loss per frequency is at most 2π/p.
